cards module¶

Card class definition for Cluedo game.

class cards.Card(name: str, category: str)¶

Bases: object

Represent a single Cluedo card with a name and category.

Used as a data container for suspect, weapon, and room cards. Implemented as a dataclass so equality and repr are generated automatically.

Attributes:

name: The card name e.g. ‘Miss Scarlett’. category: The card category e.g. ‘Suspect’, ‘Weapon’,

or ‘Room’.

Public methods:

__str__: Return a human-readable string representation.
